title: modular structural joints, fastening and repair details

specimens.name: Captive quarter-turn fastener
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE flush-mounted quarter-turn captive fastener through a SMALL thin panel fragment, clearly visible slotted turn head and flat retaining washer; show retention in panel, no loose separate screws or whole hatch.

specimens.name: Composite scarf joint
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE short bonded joint between composite laminate ends in section: a broad stepped taper overlaps the matching tapered end, exposing multiple ply steps and a thin adhesive bond line. No fasteners or complete panel.

specimens.name: Bolted structural flange splice
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE short structural splice: two aligned short metal frame ends meet at matching abutting flanges, clamped by two clearly visible bolts. The bolts belong to this one joint. No long beam, frame or additional joint.

specimens.name: Sandwich-panel threaded insert
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE small sandwich panel cutaway showing ONE metal threaded insert embedded in a local load-spreading potted core, bounded by two thin face skins; the tapped bore and surrounding potting must be legible. No extra loose hardware.

specimens.name: Dowel-aligned panel-frame joint
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE short cross-section where a removable thin panel edge aligns with an aluminium frame by ONE cylindrical locating dowel in matching socket. Show the two mating pieces and their shared dowel as ONE joint; no separate spare pins.

specimens.name: Access-hatch hinge cassette
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE compact replaceable hinge cassette connecting two short flush panel-edge fragments, with a single captive hinge pin visible at the end; no entire hatch, no loose fasteners or other hinge types.

specimens.name: Gasketed flush corner joint
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE small right-angle joint where two flat off-white modular panel edges meet flush, with a continuous dark compression gasket visible in the seam. No full wall, building, extra fasteners or mechanical hinge.

specimens.name: Replaceable abrasion strip fixing
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE short protective abrasion strip mounted flush along a short panel edge, held by two recessed flush fasteners visible on its surface. No loose fasteners, no sealing profile or separate gasket.

cohesive HD pixel art following the complete verbatim style bible
